subject: Interim GPU signalization request for NovaMetrics POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Interim GPU signalization request for NovaMetrics POC

Team,

Quick ask ahead of the NovaMetrics POC demo next week (account: NovaMetrics, contact Sarah Lopez). They will run a simultaneous live inference exercise that looks like 6–8 concurrent heavy generation sessions for ~30 minutes during the demo on Dec 6. Their SLA expectation is low latency; if our preemption hits mid-demo we risk the pilot.

Request: can we create a temporary small reserve / holdback on the dedicated GPU slate for the demo window (target: Dec 5 18:00 PST -> Dec 7 06:00 PST, ~36 hours) or approve an autoscale policy exception so these slots are not preempted by soft-evictions?

What I need from ops/product:
- Confirmation on whether a 36-hour reserve is feasible without blocking other committed capacity.
- Exact nodes/slices we would hold (so I can tell the customer).
- Guardrails for rollback and automatic release if we need to reclaim.
- Cost delta estimate for the reservation (for approval & potential billback).
- Any risk notes (latency/regression) if we change preemption thresholds.

If reserve isn't workable, please propose a fallback (burst lane + KV cache priming, or temporary prioritization rule). I can push the customer to a slightly later demo time if that materially reduces risk.

Attaching a quick snapshot request would be helpful — Kimberly, can you pull pool state for the proposed window?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interim GPU signalization request for NovaMetrics POC

On 2026-11-29 09:12, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Quick ask ahead of the NovaMetrics POC demo next week ...

Thanks for the heads-up, Jonas. A couple of clarifying questions before ops executes anything: 

1) Is the demo immovable? If we can shift to Dec 7 afternoon it reduces contention from scheduled training runs.
2) Is the ask strictly non-preempt (holdback), or would a softer guarantee (priority band + higher eviction threshold) be acceptable to the customer?
3) Do we expect test runs prior to the demo that need the same capacity (i.e., a dry run on Dec 5 evening)?

From a product perspective, I want to avoid changing global autoscale knobs unless we have a clear rollback and monitoring checklist (token-level latency spike alerts, canary trace, and automatic release). If we do the holdback, we should:
- Limit to identified slices (no blanket policy)
- Add a short TTL and an automated release if utilization < 10% for 2 hours
- Notify CS/Oncall + cost center owner when the reservation starts and ends

If Kimberly can provide the pool snapshot and candidate slices, I can sign off on the guardrail approach.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interim GPU signalization request for NovaMetrics POC

Hi — pulled the pool snapshot and sketched an operational plan. Attached: gpu_pool_snapshot.csv (small CSV with node ids, slice ids, reserved tags). Also included the autoscale-exception-form.pdf which we need completed for SRE records.

Summary:
- Candidate slices to hold: slice-7 (gp4x-1), slice-11 (gp4x-2), slice-23 (gp4x-1) — totals ~72 TFLOPS aggregated, should cover 8 heavy sessions with margin.
- Proposed window: 2026-12-05 18:00 PST -> 2026-12-07 06:00 PST (36 hours).
- Preemption policy: bump soft-eviction threshold for these slices to 95% (from default 80%) and set hard-eviction to 99.5% for emergency reclaim.
- Rollback: automated release at 2026-12-07 06:00 PST; manual release endpoint for Oncall; automatic release if aggregated utilization < 10% for a 2-hour window.
- Cost: estimated incremental cost $650 for the window (opportunity cost + reservation bookkeeping).
- Risks: small increased queuing for best-effort batch jobs during window; minor chance of higher tail latency for unrelated workloads.

Next steps:
1) Jonas: confirm you want me to tag the slices and submit the exception form to SRE.
2) Laura: please confirm guardrails above are product-acceptable.
3) Marcus: if approved, do you want me to include the incremental cost as a billable line item for the customer or absorb under sales credit?

[Attachment: gpu_pool_snapshot.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: autoscale-exception-form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Capacity & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Interim GPU signalization request for NovaMetrics POC

Forwarding with approval from my side to proceed with the plan as outlined by Kimberly.

Decision notes:
- Approve the 36-hour reservation window and the adjusted eviction thresholds.
- Sales will cover incremental cost for this POC (Marcus to absorb as demo credit) — no bill to customer for this first pilot; we want frictionless trial.
- Jonas: please send a short heads-up note to Sarah with timing and the expectation that we may do a 15-min dry run on Dec 5 evening (recommended).

Jonas — cc'ing CS & Finance offline for bookkeeping. Once Kimberly submits the exception form to SRE, treat this as green.
